name: cloudcart-plugin
description: CloudCart developer & merchant tools for OpenAI Codex — install the CloudCart CLI, search the Admin GraphQL API, validate queries, and manage your store.

interface.shortDescription: Install the CloudCart CLI, search & validate Admin GraphQL, and manage your store from chat.
interface.longDescription: Set up the CloudCart CLI and Dev MCP with one command, then manage your catalogue through natural language — products, variants, pricing, inventory, images, and bulk imports — backed by semantic search and validation against the live CloudCart Admin GraphQL schema. Includes a platform expert that answers how CloudCart is supposed to work, grounded in the CloudCart platform wiki.
defaultPrompt: How do abandoned cart emails work?
Where do I set up free shipping over 50?
